text:
liam (partnerships): Kicking off another thread focused on Marketplace publishing specifics — Azure Partner Center + AWS/GCP differences. Need a short checklist and owners.

tom (product): Key decision: public SaaS plan vs VM/Marketplace VM offer. For Azure we can publish both: SaaS offer through AppSource/Marketplace and a VM image offer.

ana (cloudops): FYI: Azure requires an ARM/managed image and publisher verification in Partner Center. Also the co-sell program requires ICP registration. For AWS we'll need SaaS integration for entitlements or an AMI for BYOVPC.

rachel (legal): Please flag whether we want the marketplaces to handle billing (marketplace-billing) or if we'll keep direct invoicing for enterprise deals. That changes required contract language and DPA scope.

liam (partnerships): Plan: marketplace billing for self-serve; private offers + invoice for enterprise. That means we publish public SKUs and prepare hidden SKUs for private offers.

chelsea (marketing): I'll need a short 1-line and long description per vendor, screenshots sized for each portal, a logo pack, and customer logos cleared for use. Also a banner image for Azure which is 700x200.

ana (cloudops): Technical owners: I'll handle AMI/managed image builds and container images for GCP. Need to confirm secure image pipeline: image signing, cloud-init, and KMS key rotation.

rachel (legal): Also flag security evidence: SOC2 report, ISO certs, and privacy policy link. Azure and AWS often surface these in the publisher checklist. We'll need a DPA and a seller's agreement draft.

tom (product): SKU/price suggestion: Starter monthly (metered token cap), Growth monthly with higher token band, Enterprise private offers with negotiated pricing. Include support tiers: community, standard, premium.

liam (partnerships): marketplace-bot create ticket MP-298 with subtasks for ARM template, AMI, SKU matrix, legal checklist, and marketing assets.

marketplace-bot: Created MP-298: "Marketplace: Azure/AWS/GCP onboarding - Partner Center + Images". Subtasks: ARM template (ana), AMI build (ana), SKU matrix (tom), Legal docs (rachel), Marketing assets (chelsea).

chelsea (marketing): Quick Q about co-branding: do we have permission for partner badges on the listing? We'll need logo permissions and a short partner description if co-sell is enabled.

liam (partnerships): We'll coordinate partner badges later; for now collect logos and partner names. Chelsea, can you draft the copy for the three vendors?

chelsea (marketing): Yes — draft for Azure first, then reuse structure for AWS & GCP. ETA: two working days.

ana (cloudops): Implementation note: AWS SaaS integration requires us to implement the AWS Marketplace SaaS Connector (entitlement callback URL) and token exchange. Spike required to test the entitlement webhook and customer identifiers.

tom (product): Add spike AM-12: verify entitlement flow and mapping to customer accounts in our billing system. Also add GCP SaaS connector spike.

rachel (legal): For EU customers, the listing must state data residency options. We should add a short FAQ entry in the listing about EU region availability and logging retention.

liam (partnerships): Good. Also need to confirm support SLAs surfaced in the listing: response time and escalation contacts for paid tiers.

chelsea (marketing): I'll include an FAQ section and the SLA snippets. We should avoid exact SLA numbers that might conflict with Dedicated/Private offerings. Use product-specific wording.

ana (cloudops): For the VM/AMI we need to bake in a license fetch step from the Partner Center or marketplace entitlement system, and support BYOK/HSM integration. I'll sketch terraform + cloud-init.

marketplace-bot: Reminder set: "MP-298 standup" in 48 hours.

liam (partnerships): Next steps: ana (cloudops) starts AMI/ARM drafts, tom builds SKU spreadsheet, rachel drafts EULA + DPA, chelsea drafts copy/assets. We'll reconvene in 48 hours.

ana (cloudops): Starting AMI pipeline today, will post CI link to MP-298 when ready.

rachel (legal): I'll post contract checklist and required evidence items to MP-298 by EOD.

chelsea (marketing): Will upload logo checklist and initial copy by tomorrow.

Tom (product): Working on SKU matrix now.

liam (partnerships): Awesome. If anyone hits vendor-specific oddities (publisher vetting, tax forms), flag in this thread so we can escalate to the vendor rep.

chelsea (marketing): Noted. Also propose a soft launch for AWS public SaaS first, then expand to Azure & GCP. Staggered launch reduces review fatigue. :sparkles:
